Old_Answer: If you’ve been eating Olive Garden all your life and you go to Italy, would the food taste better or worse to you? Most Americans find that real Italian food is worse than Olive Garden. Americanized Italian food like Olive Garden’s menu has quite a bit more salt and sugar than its Italian counterparts. Our pastas, breads, and sauces therefore have trained the American palate to prefer sweeter tasting foods rather than fresher more natural foods. It’s also important to note that in Italy it is the pasta that is the focus not the sauce. American tend to load their pasta with extra sauce, while Italians have lighter sauces that showcase the many varieties of pasta available. Italians also use fresh cheese, which is much less salty than the varieties in the US and therefore doesn’t taste as good to Americans. Americanized Italian food is not authentic, but it’s delicious to American palates. Italian food is authentic and takes some getting used to.
